s:aomori/hirosaki-castle: Hirosaki Park in late April: the outer moat completely carpeted with fallen pink cherry petals, old cherry trees in full bloom arching over the water from grassy stone-walled banks, the small white three-tiered castle keep with grey-green roofs visible beyond, soft morning light, calm air.
s:aomori/oirase-stream: Low view beside the Oirase Stream in late October: clear water tumbling over moss-covered boulders in gentle cascades, fallen leaves on the rocks, a beech forest in yellow, orange and red foliage closing overhead, a narrow earthen path along the bank, soft overcast light.
s:aomori/hakkoda-ropeway: Summit of Mount Hakkoda in February: rows of fir trees completely encased in thick white rime ice and snow, shaped like hunched snow monsters, standing on a snowy slope, rolling white mountains beyond, a cable car line in the distance, deep blue sky after a snowfall.
s:aomori/sukayu-onsen: Exterior of Sukayu Onsen in deep midwinter: a large old wooden hot-spring inn with steep dark roofs and weathered timber walls, buried in snow piled two metres high along the road, snow walls cut on both sides, steam drifting from the building, fir forest behind, light snowfall.
s:aomori/sannai-maruyama: The reconstructed Jomon tower at the Sannai-Maruyama Site: six massive bare chestnut log pillars supporting three open wooden platforms, beside a long thatched pit dwelling with a low earth-coloured roof, on a wide green lawn, early summer afternoon, blue sky with a few clouds.
s:aomori/aomori-museum-of-art: Exterior of the Aomori Museum of Art: stark white rectangular box volumes resting over excavated trenches of bare brown earth, clean geometric white walls with few windows, a green lawn and young trees around, low-angle view in clear summer light, blue sky.
s:aomori/nebuta-warasse: Inside a dark exhibition hall: a giant illuminated Nebuta lantern float glowing from within, a fierce painted warrior figure with flowing robes, brandished sword and swirling waves in vivid red, blue, black and white on paper over a wire frame, viewed from a low angle, small distant visitors at its base.
s:aomori/juniko: Aoike pond at Juniko in early summer: a small, startlingly cobalt-blue pool of crystal-clear water in a beech forest, sunken branches visible on the pale bottom, green leaves reflected at the edges, dappled sunlight filtering through the canopy around midday.
f:aomori/nokke-don: Overhead view of a nokke-don in a simple bowl on a market counter: white rice topped with assorted sashimi chosen piece by piece, red tuna, pale scallops, salmon, glossy orange salmon roe and sweet shrimp, a dab of wasabi, blurred seafood stalls behind, natural light.
f:aomori/apples: A woven basket of glossy red Aomori apples on a rustic wooden table, a few with stems and green leaves, one apple cut in half showing crisp pale yellow flesh and a star-shaped core, soft autumn window light, shallow depth of field.
f:aomori/hotate: Kaiyaki miso: a large scallop shell used as a pan over a small tabletop burner, scallop pieces simmering in beaten egg and miso with chopped green onion, bubbling at the edges, a bowl of rice beside, 45-degree angle, warm izakaya light, shallow depth of field.
f:aomori/senbei-jiru: A small earthenware pot of Hachinohe senbei-jiru at 45 degrees: a soy-based broth with broken pieces of pale, rimmed nanbu wheat crackers softening in it, chicken, burdock, carrot, mushrooms and green onion, steam rising, wooden table, natural light, shallow depth of field.
s:iwate/chusonji: The Tsukimizaka approach to Chuson-ji in early November: a sloping path flanked by towering old cedar trees, red and orange maple leaves glowing in the understory, a weathered wooden temple hall with a dark roof at the top, small distant visitors, soft filtered light.
s:iwate/motsuji: The Heian-period pure land garden at Motsu-ji in late June: a large tranquil pond with a curving stony shore and a rocky promontory, old pine trees, foundation stones of vanished halls on a green lawn, a bed of purple and white irises in bloom, overcast soft light.
s:iwate/geibikei: A flat-bottomed wooden boat poled by a boatman at the stern gliding up the calm green river of Geibikei Gorge, sheer grey limestone cliffs rising vertically on both sides, red and yellow autumn foliage on the ledges, still water reflections, soft overcast light.
s:iwate/genbikei: Genbikei Gorge from a footbridge: emerald water rushing through a narrow channel of grey eroded rock pocked with smooth round potholes, a rope line stretched across the gorge to a small wooden teahouse on the far bank, a little basket hanging from it, green summer trees, bright light.
s:iwate/ishiwari-zakura: The Ishiwarizakura in Morioka in mid-April: an old cherry tree with pale pink blossoms growing straight out of a deep crack splitting an enormous granite boulder, supported trunk and wide crown, a fenced courtyard and bare-branched trees around, soft spring light.
s:iwate/koiwai-farm: The lone cherry tree at Koiwai Farm in early May: a single broad cherry tree in full pale pink bloom on a small rise in a green pasture, the snow-streaked cone of Mount Iwate rising directly behind, clear blue sky, early morning light, calm air.
s:iwate/jodogahama: Jodogahama on the Sanriku coast: jagged white rhyolite rock islets topped with dark green pine trees lining a calm shallow bay, clear emerald and turquoise water over a white pebble beach, small boats in the distance, bright summer sunshine, blue sky.
f:iwate/wanko-soba: A table set for wanko soba seen at 45 degrees: a stack of empty small red lacquer bowls, a hand tipping a mouthful of soba into a bowl, side dishes of salmon roe, minced tuna, grated daikon, nori and chopped green onion, warm restaurant light, shallow depth of field.
f:iwate/morioka-reimen: A large bowl of Morioka reimen at 45 degrees: clear chilled beef broth with translucent, chewy pale noodles, topped with red kimchi, slices of beef, half a boiled egg, sliced cucumber and a wedge of seasonal fruit, metal chopsticks on the side, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:iwate/jajamen: A plate of Morioka jajamen from above: thick flat white noodles topped with a mound of dark brown meat miso, julienned cucumber, chopped green onion and grated ginger, a small dish of chili oil and garlic beside, wooden counter, natural light.
f:iwate/mochi-zen: Overhead view of an Ichinoseki mochi set on a lacquered tray: several small bowls of soft white rice cakes, each with a different topping, green edamame paste, black sesame, sweet red bean, grated daikon, natto and ginger soy, pickles and clear soup beside, natural light.
s:miyagi/matsushima: Elevated view over Matsushima Bay on a calm morning: dozens of small pale rock islands topped with dark green pine trees scattered across smooth blue water, a small sightseeing boat leaving a wake, a long vermilion footbridge to one island in the distance, light haze, soft early sunlight.
s:miyagi/zuiganji: The approach to Zuigan-ji: a straight gravel path through tall old cedar trees, on one side a weathered cliff face carved with caves holding small stone statues and memorial stones, green moss everywhere, shafts of soft light through the trees, quiet morning.
s:miyagi/zuihoden: Zuihoden mausoleum among tall cedars: a compact hall in glossy black lacquer covered with intricate brightly painted carvings in red, green and blue, gold fittings and gilded details under sweeping roofs, stone steps leading up, soft filtered light in the forest.
s:miyagi/sendai-castle: Sendai Castle ruins at dusk: the silhouette of a bronze equestrian samurai statue with a crescent-moon helmet on a stone pedestal at the edge of the hill, the city of Sendai spreading below with lights coming on, green hills in the distance, orange and blue twilight sky.
s:miyagi/akiu-onsen: A stone open-air bath at an Akiu Onsen inn in late October, empty and steaming, overlooking a forested river valley in red, orange and yellow foliage, a wooden roof edge in the corner, rocks framing clear hot water, soft afternoon light.
s:miyagi/naruko-gorge: Naruko Gorge in late October from the rest-house viewpoint: a deep V-shaped gorge with steep walls blazing in red, orange and yellow foliage, a red arch road bridge spanning it, a small local train emerging from a tunnel on the cliffside, the river far below, clear autumn light.
s:miyagi/hitome-senbonzakura: The Shiroishi River embankment in mid-April: a long line of cherry trees in full pale pink bloom stretching along the riverbank, the calm river beside, the snow-capped Zao mountain range in the background, clear blue sky, soft late-morning light.
s:miyagi/zao-okama: View from the rim of Zao Okama in summer: a round crater lake of vivid emerald-green water lying in a steep bowl of grey and rust-brown striped volcanic rock, a small crescent of mist on the far slope, clear blue sky, midday sun.
f:miyagi/gyutan: A Sendai gyutan set at 45 degrees: thick slices of charcoal-grilled beef tongue with grill marks on a plate with pickled napa cabbage and green chili miso, a bowl of barley rice and a bowl of clear oxtail soup with green onion, wooden tray, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:miyagi/zunda-mochi: A small ceramic plate of zunda mochi from 45 degrees: soft white rice cakes generously covered with coarse bright green mashed edamame paste, a cup of green tea beside, light wooden table, natural window light, shallow depth of field.
f:miyagi/matsushima-oysters: Matsushima oysters grilling on a metal grate over charcoal, shells cracked open, plump juicy oysters bubbling in their own liquid, steam rising, a lemon wedge on the side, close 45-degree angle, warm natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:miyagi/sasakamaboko: Several bamboo-leaf-shaped sasa kamaboko fish cakes on a small plate, pale cream with golden-brown grilled spots, one freshly grilled on a stick, a green bamboo leaf garnish, wooden counter, natural light, 45-degree angle, shallow depth of field.
s:akita/kakunodate: The samurai district of Kakunodate in late April: a wide quiet street lined with black wooden board fences and gated samurai residences, old weeping cherry trees cascading pale pink blossoms over the walls, tall fir trees behind, soft morning light, a few small distant pedestrians.
s:akita/nyuto-onsen: Tsurunoyu at Nyuto Onsen in winter: an empty milky blue-white open-air hot spring pool steaming in the cold, ringed by rocks and deep snow, a long low wooden building with a thatched roof behind, snow-laden beech forest, gentle snowfall, soft grey light.
s:akita/lake-tazawa: Lake Tazawa on a clear day: deep cobalt-blue water stretching to forested mountains, a small golden statue of a maiden standing on a rock just off the shore, gentle ripples, a pebble beach, bright summer sunshine and a few white clouds.
s:akita/dakigaeri-gorge: Dakigaeri Gorge in early November: a vermilion suspension bridge spanning a rocky gorge above a milky cobalt-blue river, steep slopes covered in red, orange and yellow foliage, a narrow riverside trail, soft overcast light.
s:akita/senshu-park: Senshu Park in late April: pink cherry blossoms overhanging the calm outer moat, grassy earthen embankments and old stone walls, a white two-storey reconstructed watchtower on the wooded hill above, soft spring sunshine.
s:akita/namahage-museum: Inside the Namahage Museum: a large hall with tiered rows of over a hundred carved namahage demon masks in red, blue and gold with bulging eyes and bared teeth, straw costumes hanging beside them, dim warm spotlighting.
f:akita/kiritanpo: An earthenware pot of kiritanpo nabe at 45 degrees: diagonally cut toasted rice sticks simmering in golden chicken broth with pieces of chicken, burdock shavings, maitake mushrooms, Japanese parsley and green onion, steam rising, tatami-room table, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:akita/inaniwa-udon: Chilled Inaniwa udon on a glass plate over ice: thin, flat, glossy cream-white noodles neatly folded, a cup of dark dipping sauce, grated ginger, wasabi and chopped green onion beside, wooden table, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:akita/hinai-jidori: Hinai-jidori oyakodon in a lidded ceramic bowl at 45 degrees: tender chicken pieces in soft, glossy, barely set egg over rice, green mitsuba leaves on top, pickles and miso soup beside, wooden table, warm natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:akita/iburigakko: Slices of iburigakko on a small dark ceramic plate: smoked pickled daikon with brown outer skin and pale yellow interior, paired with slices of cream cheese, a small cup of sake beside, wooden izakaya counter, warm light, shallow depth of field.
s:yamagata/yamadera: View from the Godaido hall balcony at Yamadera in early November: weathered wooden temple buildings perched on steep grey rock cliffs among red, orange and yellow maple foliage, the valley village and river far below, forested mountains beyond, crisp clear autumn light.
s:yamagata/ginzan-onsen: Ginzan Onsen on a snowy evening: three- and four-storey old wooden ryokan with balconies and carved facades lining both sides of a narrow river, warm gas lamps glowing along the stone-edged banks, small wooden footbridges, snow on the roofs and railings, gentle snowfall at blue hour.
s:yamagata/zao-juhyo: Zao Snow Monsters in early February: a field of fir trees completely coated in thick wind-sculpted rime ice and snow, forming tall white hunched figures on a broad snowy slope, a ropeway line and small distant skiers, deep blue sky after a snowfall, bright low sun.
s:yamagata/zao-onsen: A wooden public bathhouse in Zao Onsen village in winter: a small timber building with a steep snowy roof, steam drifting from milky white sulphur water flowing in a stone channel along a narrow sloping lane, deep snow banks, soft overcast light.
s:yamagata/mogami-river: A long flat-bottomed wooden sightseeing boat with a low roof gliding down the broad green Mogami River through a steep gorge, the boatman at the stern, slopes covered in red and yellow autumn foliage, a thin white waterfall on the far bank, soft overcast light.
s:yamagata/mount-haguro: The National Treasure five-storey pagoda on Mount Haguro: a tall unpainted dark wooden pagoda with layered shingle roofs standing alone among enormous ancient cedar trees, a stone path and moss-covered ground, misty early summer morning with soft diffuse light.
s:yamagata/uesugi-shrine: The approach to Uesugi Shrine in Yonezawa in late April: a stone bridge over the old castle moat, cherry trees in full pale pink bloom along the stone-lined banks, a large stone torii and a dark-roofed shrine hall among pines beyond, soft spring sunshine.
f:yamagata/yonezawa-beef: Yonezawa beef sukiyaki at 45 degrees: thin slices of heavily marbled pink wagyu in a shallow cast-iron pan with tofu, green onion, shiitake, shirataki noodles and chrysanthemum greens simmering in a dark sweet soy broth, a raw egg in a small bowl beside, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:yamagata/imoni: A bowl of Yamagata imoni at 45 degrees: a soy-based broth with chunks of tender taro, thin slices of beef, konnyaku and long-cut green onion, steam rising, served in a simple ceramic bowl on a wooden table, warm autumn natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:yamagata/cherries: A white bowl overflowing with glossy pale red and yellow Satonishiki cherries with long green stems, a few loose cherries on a light wooden table, droplets of water on the fruit, bright natural summer light, 45-degree angle, shallow depth of field.
f:yamagata/hiyashi-ramen: A wide bowl of Yamagata hiyashi ramen at 45 degrees: clear chilled soy-sauce broth with ice cubes floating on top, wavy noodles, slices of chashu pork, bamboo shoots, a halved boiled egg, nori and green onion, condensation on the bowl, wooden counter, bright natural light, shallow depth of field.
s:fukushima/tsuruga-castle: Tsuruga Castle in mid-April: the five-storey white castle keep with distinctive reddish-brown tiled roofs rising above massive grey stone walls, surrounded by cherry trees in full pale pink bloom, the moat in the foreground, clear blue spring sky, soft morning light.
s:fukushima/ouchi-juku: Elevated view from the hillside at the end of Ouchi-juku in winter: a straight snowy street lined on both sides by rows of thick thatched-roof wooden houses heavy with snow, small water channels along the road, forested mountains behind, soft grey light and light snowfall.
s:fukushima/goshikinuma: Bishamon-numa at Goshikinuma in late October: a still pond of vivid cobalt and emerald blue water ringed by red, orange and yellow autumn foliage, the rugged brown crater wall of Mount Bandai rising behind, calm reflections, clear morning light.
s:fukushima/tadami-line-bridge: The Tadami River First Bridge seen from the hillside viewpoint: a steel arch railway bridge spanning a wide calm river in a forested valley, a single small two-car local train crossing, thin morning mist lying on the water, hills in red and orange autumn colour, soft dawn light.
s:fukushima/sazaedo: Sazaedo on Iimoriyama: a tall, slender, unpainted hexagonal wooden hall with dark weathered timbers and a shingled roof, set among tall cedar trees on a hillside, a stone path and moss at its base, soft filtered daylight.
s:fukushima/miharu-takizakura: The Miharu Takizakura in mid-April: an enormous ancient weeping cherry tree with a gnarled trunk and long cascading branches of pink blossoms falling like a waterfall almost to the ground, a grassy slope and wooden fence around, clear morning light, calm air.
s:fukushima/hanamiyama: Hanamiyama Park in mid-April: a gently rolling hillside covered with blooming trees in layered pink cherry, yellow forsythia, white magnolia and deep pink peach blossom, narrow paths winding through, the snow-capped Azuma mountains in the distance, soft spring sunshine.
s:fukushima/tonohetsuri: To-no-Hetsuri in late October: a row of tall eroded rock pillars and overhanging cliffs like towers along a green river, a small wooden suspension bridge leading across to them, trees on top in red and orange autumn colour, soft overcast light.
f:fukushima/kitakata-ramen: A bowl of Kitakata ramen at 45 degrees: clear golden soy-sauce and pork-bone broth, wide flat curly noodles, several thin slices of chashu pork covering the surface, bamboo shoots, naruto fish cake and chopped green onion, steam rising, wooden counter, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:fukushima/negi-soba: A bowl of Ouchi-juku negi soba at 45 degrees: cold soba noodles in dark broth topped with grated daikon and bonito flakes, a whole long green onion laid across the bowl to be used as chopsticks, on a wooden table in a traditional room, soft daylight, shallow depth of field.
f:fukushima/sauce-katsudon: Aizu sauce katsudon at 45 degrees: a lidded bowl with two oversized golden pork cutlets glazed with dark sweet sauce, overhanging a bed of shredded cabbage over rice, the lid propped against the bowl, pickles beside, wooden table, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:fukushima/kozuyu: Overhead view of Aizu kozuyu in a shallow red lacquer bowl: clear dried-scallop broth with small cubes of taro, sliced shiitake, carrot, konnyaku and tiny wheat-gluten rings, a lacquered tray and chopsticks beside, soft natural light.
f:fukushima/fukushima-peach: Several ripe Fukushima peaches with blush-pink and creamy yellow skin on a light wooden table, one cut open showing juicy white flesh and a red-tinged pit, droplets of juice, bright summer natural light, 45-degree angle, shallow depth of field.
